title: Flow · The Lantern Works
notes: Interpretive project families, connected working copies, service machinery and truthful traces; work is a lantern that keeps its seal from unlit intent through paper panes, a running sweep, a cracked pane, a gold mend and a lit pane showing the recorded preview. Rails, tethers, threads and carried seals distinguish belonging, attribution, collaboration and delivery. A creative baseline rather than fixed visual rules.
